dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I’m checking on the status of my home improvement loan application. Can you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or if it’s still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional home improvement loan has been approved, and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know! Can you please tell me what my assigned interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your assigned interest rate is 6.375%. The total costs associated with the loan are $3,144.10.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you also tell me if this loan is classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) loan, or if it has any negative amortization features? Also, has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features. According to the record, after origination your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that. One last question: what does my debt-to-income (DTI) ratio mean for my application? Was it a factor in the loan approval or the terms I received?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio falls between 20% and just under 30%. This percentage reflects the portion of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. The record does not include details about how your DTI ratio specifically affected the approval or terms; it only shows the value used during your application review.
